reviews.title: What Our Diners Say
reviews.subtitle: Real feedback from local diners, families, and travelers dining at Pearl Hotel.
reviews.addReviewSubtitle: Your feedback helps us maintain premium quality dining.
reviews.reviewPlaceholder: Write your experience with our food and service...
reviews.dishPlaceholder: e.g. Chicken Kottu, Ceylon Milk Tea...

item1.comment: Best Chicken Kottu in Jaffna! The godamba roti is super fresh, perfectly shredded with hot spicy gravy. Ceylon Milk Tea afterwards was top notch!

item2.comment: Ordered Chicken Dum Biriyani and Paal Appam. Delivered steaming hot via WhatsApp order. Rich authentic taste with generous chicken portions.

item3.comment: Stopped by Pearl Hotel at Navatkuli junction while driving on A9 road. Outstanding seafood devil prawns and fresh King Coconut! Must visit.

item4.comment: Egg Appam with Pol Sambol for breakfast was amazing. Quick service and very clean environment. Their Cardamom Special Tea is aromatic!
